basis: Existing same-day official venue research reused; venue pages and new official hotel pages reopened where stated. No outreach, forms, bookings or live date-price search submitted.

sections.title: Venue, ceremony and cocktail rooms
sections.budget_scope: Single venue-driven envelope: shop toward $30,000; hard ceiling $32,139; financial fits requires $31,139 or less. All room, food/bar, staff, rental, cake, ready-room, parking and required-fee costs share that envelope.

vendors.name: Old Hickory Golf Club
vendors.published_price: Wedding package, minimums and required wedding fees unknown. The $119.50 figure in older analysis is a solver ceiling, not a price.
vendors.scope: Club ballroom; advertised furniture, standard linens, tableware, dance floor, service personnel, cake cutting, changing rooms and coordinator. In-house wedding food/bar proposal is the intended route.
vendors.gaps: 185 rounds with dance floor; heated indoor ceremony/holding plan; separate cocktails; full access/flip/strike; outside-vendor and candle permissions; end time; coordinator scope; parking charges; 2027 all-in price and dates.
vendors.budget_status: Unknown; prioritize requested-interest quote, not a confirmed budget fit.

vendors.name: The Villa — Grand Ballroom / Catering by Uptown
vendors.published_price: Wedding package and date-dependent food/beverage minimum unknown.
vendors.scope: Package route with mandatory in-house food and alcohol; outside cake permitted. Grand Ballroom advertised for 125–250 and indoor weather backup offered. Additional floral/decor installation and removal require a licensed professional unless an exception is confirmed.
vendors.gaps: 185 rounds plus dance floor, heated ceremony and separate cocktail allocation, precise included rentals/rooms, access/strike hours, paid rehearsal, candle/outside-DJ rules, parking charges and complete 2027 quote.
vendors.budget_status: Unknown; compare a complete package, not a bare room price.

vendors.name: Oak Room at Sandy Spring Volunteer Fire Department
vendors.published_price: Saturday rental $3,000 for 8 hours; outside caterer $500; contracted extra hours $200/hour. Current 2027 proposal unknown; model applies 4% to dated costs.
vendors.scope: Hall route: published 220 seated with dance floor, tables/chairs, kitchen, breakout room and free parking. Venue approves licensed/insured caterer and qualified bartender; renter supplies table setup/strike labor.
vendors.gaps: Rounds layout, heated ceremony or priced flip with 185-person holding room, breakout/cocktail capacity, getting-ready solution, all access hours and complete catering/rental/cleanup proposal.
vendors.budget_status: Unknown; published rental does not establish complete wedding cost or required room flow.

vendors.name: The Gathering Place — Patuxent Grand Ballroom
vendors.published_price: Rent and required room fees unpublished; getting-ready suite has an additional charge.
vendors.scope: Hall route: ballroom advertised up to 265 seated with dance floor, movable partitions, venue table/chair setup and licensed outside catering permitted. Preferred list includes MISSION BBQ.
vendors.gaps: Approved 185-person rounds/dance layout, heated ceremony/holding and separate cocktail sequence, actual table sizes, rental/partition/ready-room prices, cleanup/strike duties, permits, parking and full 2027 quote.
vendors.budget_status: Unknown; zero-rent models are incomplete subtotals.

vendors.name: Crowne Plaza College Park — Grand Ballroom + Annapolis room
vendors.published_price: Wedding package unknown. Current hotel amenities page publishes $15/day parking; event waiver/2027 event charge unknown.
vendors.scope: Hotel package route: fact sheet lists Grand Ballroom banquet capacity 320 and Annapolis reception capacity 250. Onsite hotel rooms can simplify the overnight plan if separately quoted.
vendors.gaps: 185 rounds plus dance floor, heated ceremony/holding allocation, furniture/service package, actual access hours, outside vendors/candles and 2027 total. Old fact-sheet free-parking claim conflicts with current hotel parking tariff; written event terms required.
vendors.budget_status: Unknown; do not credit free event parking pending written confirmation.

sections.recommendation: Request the same full room/staffing timeline and complete 2027 proposal from these five routes. Old Hickory remains a priority because of the couple’s interest, while Villa and two hall routes provide service/value comparisons. Do not choose by hypothetical ceiling or rent alone.

sections.title: Wedding-night room and conditional getting-ready fallback
sections.budget_scope: $600 wedding-night room is outside the venue envelope. A separate getting-ready need is inside the venue envelope; the model carries $600 if needed. Do not count a single booking twice or assume one night permits morning access.

vendors.name: Home2 Suites by Hilton Woodbridge Potomac Mills
vendors.published_price: November 2027 room rate unknown; published parking $12/day.
vendors.scope: Woodbridge/Old Hickory cluster option at 14005 Telegraph Road; suites with in-room kitchens; published check-in 3pm and checkout 11am.
vendors.gaps: Actual room category, date-specific tax-inclusive total within $600 overnight allowance, incidental hold, parking, cancellations, venue drive time, early/day-use/prior-night access and permission for preparation team.
vendors.budget_status: Quote needed; hotel night does not establish getting-ready access.

vendors.name: Residence Inn by Marriott Fulton at Maple Lawn
vendors.published_price: November 2027 room rate unknown; official page lists complimentary onsite parking.
vendors.scope: Fulton option to compare for Clarksville/Gathering Place and Sandy Spring/Oak routes; studio and one-/two-bedroom suites, published 3pm check-in and 11am checkout.
vendors.gaps: Verify drive time to selected venue, actual room/policy and 2027 total including taxes, incidental hold and preparation access. Airport shuttle is not provided; no wedding shuttle assumed.
vendors.budget_status: Quote needed; $600 is a cap, not a quoted room price.

vendors.name: Crowne Plaza College Park — overnight room
vendors.published_price: November 2027 room rate unknown; published parking $15/day and $150 incidental deposit at check-in.
vendors.scope: Onsite overnight option if Crowne Plaza hosts the wedding; Greenbelt cluster comparison for The Villa, with actual drive time still to verify. Published check-in 3pm, checkout 11am; hotel says it has no shuttle.
vendors.gaps: Package-included night versus separate charge, room type, tax-inclusive total, deposit release terms, early access/day-use and event-parking waiver.
vendors.budget_status: Quote needed; incidental deposit is a cash requirement, not automatically an expense.

sections.recommendation: Choose after venue selection. Ask the selected hotel for actual November 2027 terms and guaranteed preparation access if needed; all published 3pm check-ins are too late to assume morning preparation. Any extra night/day-use charge must fit the correct existing allocation.

responsibilities.owner: Selected venue event manager with caterer and coordinator
responsibilities.completion_evidence: One dimensioned plan: 185 at rounds with dance floor retained, heated ceremony and adequate holding room if flipping, separate cocktails, accessibility and service aisles.

responsibilities.owner: Venue/caterer/rental crew as assigned in writing; coordinator supervises only unless physical labor contracted
responsibilities.completion_evidence: Named workers, arrival/departure times and fee; no essential labor silently assigned to guests.

responsibilities.owner: Selected venue if suitable early access is included; otherwise selected hotel with written preparation permission
responsibilities.completion_evidence: Guaranteed hours, people/vendors permitted, adequate space, early/day-use/prior-night charges.

responsibilities.owner: Selected venue or its approved parking operator
responsibilities.completion_evidence: Guest/vendor car capacity, accessible spaces/dropoff, price or written waiver, nighttime pickup and vehicle-removal rules.

responsibilities.owner: Venue-approved licensed security or required police detail, arranged through venue
responsibilities.completion_evidence: Whether required; headcount threshold, number of staff, paid hours, invoice and included versus extra charge. No independent security vendor selected before venue rules.

responsibilities.owner: Venue license holder or approved licensed caterer, with required government issuer if applicable
responsibilities.completion_evidence: Who purchases/serves alcohol, whose license covers event, permit type/fees/deadline, insurance requirements; never assume a dry-hire bartender supplies a license.

responsibilities.owner: Couple and selected hotel, only if terms create no unfunded obligation
responsibilities.completion_evidence: No automatic couple-paid room block, attrition guarantee, shuttle or guest transportation under the $0 category.

critical_update.finding: Current official amenities page lists $15/day parking and no shuttle; prior fact sheet lists free parking. Event waiver is unknown.
critical_update.implication: Remove any unconditional free-parking claim; quote event parking before financial fit. Ordinary hotel parking does not prove wedding-event tariff.

limits: No hotel rate for the wedding dates was obtained; generic search snippets or other dates are not prices.
The 60-minute DC drive requirement and hotel-to-venue travel times require actual route checks.
